note: How the F11 Map page's globe looks (src/ui/globe_view.gd). Each pin kind is a small shape (star, triangle, square, diamond, cross, circle, ring, planet, cruiser) in a colour; 'planet' and 'cruiser' are the icons beside the off-planet places; 'ink' is the globe's own lines (null = the player's HUD colour). 'player' is you (a pulsing triangle that points the way you look); 'goal' is the waypoint's colour: the pin it is at flashes, and out where no pin is it shows as its own marker. 'owners' recolours a pin the locals hold (Territory): green, and yellow-green while their supplies there run short; round a held outpost a ring of radius ring_px drains as their hold runs down (ring_back_alpha the empty part). Issue #425: once the cruiser has fallen the Remnant's outposts get the ring too (in their own red), and remnant_short (orange) while they run short and you could resupply them. Under the grid the ball's own ground shows faintly ('terrain', GlobeTerrain + globe_ground.gdshader): its real heights baked at 'size' texels (latitude by longitude), tinted from 'low' to 'high' by height and 'rock' where the mesas stand, the slopes lifted 'relief' times and lit from the top left by 'shade' (fading out as a texel grows from fade_px[0] to fade_px[1] pixels on screen, zoomed in, where the light would show the texels); until the bake is done the ball is the plain 'sea'. 'cruiser' is the Remnant cruiser's cutaway (src/ui/cruiser_map_view.gd): the real ship rendered from starboard, 'stretch' times taller than it is so its rooms can be clicked, on 'space' lit by 'ambient'; floors, ramps and furniture painted by 'finishes', the hull, walls, trim and glass drawn as light in 'ink' ('ghost': fill face on, rim edge on), the screens, reactor and engines glowing; the hull's silhouette traced over it at 'outline_alpha'. Names and what goes on the map: content/core/flow/map.json.
